$comment: The rta-grid: locked constants of the Rtambhareshvara murti, measured from reference/shivalinga-sanctum-reference.jpeg (front-ellipse pixel ratios) and optically tuned on the construction drawings. Every constructed mark and every layout derives from these numbers — see ../rtambhareshvara-murti.md §4/§8. construct.py generates the drawings from this file.

rings.$comment: Plan-view radii normalized to the rim outer radius = 1.0. 'measured' = photo ratio; the working value is the tuned one used by all drawings.

nali.$comment: The spout that breaks the circle — the system's index mark. Width spans the linga diameter; it points toward the devotee (south, 6 o'clock) in operational marks; the north-pointing (12 o'clock) consecrated orientation is a Phase-2 study.

elevation.$comment: Front-elevation proportions, same normalization (rim outer radius = 1.0 => basin full width 2.0).

layout.$comment: Web/print layout inherits the murti's constants: 12 columns like the 12 spokes; spacing steps on the 6/12/24 doubling; rotational elements only at 30°/15° steps.
